summary: Production-ready Python framework for building AI agents you can watch, understand and control, with tools, MCP and voice.

sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: AgentScope is an agent framework in Python. Version 2.0 provides the essential building blocks (ReAct agents, a toolkit for Python tools and MCP servers, models, context management, an event system, permissions and middleware) and relies on models' own reasoning and tool use instead of strict prompts.
sixtySeconds.problem: Building reliable agents means handling tools, context limits, permissions and observability. AgentScope packages these so you can build agents you can see and trust.
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Choose it for a well-supported framework with human-in-the-loop permissions, team pipelines, SOPs and realtime voice support across major providers.
requirements: An API key for your model provider

overview: Building blocks include the ReAct agent (structured output and realtime interruption), a toolkit over Python tools and MCP servers, models for LLMs, embeddings and TTS across providers such as OpenAI and Anthropic, automatic context compaction, an event bus, a permission and human-in-the-loop system, and middleware hooks.
Recent additions include TeamPipeline (a leader agent delegating to members), SOPs for multi-step tasks, realtime voice agents and voice profile management.
Install from PyPI with uv pip install agentscope, or from source. AgentScope is Apache 2.0 licensed.
